## Native Door to Door port (P1731), 11/03 (jcode)

Charles's decision: Door to Door is a **native clone inside Dial Smart**, on Dial Smart's own Supabase
(`emonjusymdripmkvtttc`) - **never an iframe or SSO embed of DoorBoss**, and never a stripped subset. The
reference is the working DoorBoss app (`docs/wholesale/doorboss-app/index.prod.html`, v22.6); we port its
behaviour, not its markup. **This supersedes the "every pack screen is a placeholder" claim above for Door to
Door:** `Dashboard.tsx` now routes `d2d-knock-list` and `d2d-map` to real screens.

Both slices sit behind the `door_to_door` pack, so `Knock list` and `Map` appear in the sidebar only once that
pack is enabled (Packs screen -> toggle; the toggle is live).

**Slice 1 - knock list (commits `b231c1e6`, `69f0b681`).** Migration `20261102234500_door_to_door_core.sql` is
applied to live. Live row counts: `d2d_properties` 201, `d2d_knocks` 76, `d2d_territories` 0.
`src/lib/d2dApi.ts` is the typed data layer (typed from the live schema); `DoorToDoorKnockList.tsx` and
`KnockDetailSheet.tsx` are the screens.

**Slice 2 - map (this session).** Files:

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `src/lib/geo.ts` | `LatLng`, `GeoBounds`, `haversine`, `pathLength`, `pointInPoly`, `hasLatLng` |
| `src/lib/d2dMap.ts` | pure decisions: territory polygon/assignees, `MAP_FILTERS`, basemap ids, route candidates |
| `src/lib/d2dMapLayers.ts` | the Leaflet layers, including the offline schematic fallback |
| `src/lib/d2dMapEngine.ts` | the engine: mount/destroy, filters, route, trail, draw, `nextPick` |
| `src/hooks/useGeolocation.ts` | `watchPosition` plus staleness and accuracy state |
| `src/components/packs/DoorMap.tsx` | the Leaflet host and its overlay (chips, FABs, draw bar, Knock next card) |
| `src/components/packs/DoorToDoorMap.tsx` | the screen: data load, GPS pill, dialogs, territory save |

Nav wiring: `src/components/Dashboard.tsx:517` (`case 'd2d-map':`, with a lazy import beside the knock list),
`src/lib/packs.ts:79` (`{ id: 'd2d-map', label: 'Map', icon: 'Map' }`), and `Map` registered in `PACK_ICONS` at
`src/components/DashboardSidebar.tsx:200`. Leaflet lands in the screen's own lazy chunk
(`dist/assets/DoorToDoorMap-*.js`, 205 kB, CSS a separate 14.8 kB chunk), so no other tab pays for it.

Gates (FACT, 11/03): `npm run typecheck` green, `npm run build` green, `src/lib/__tests__/d2dMap.test.ts`
91 passed.

Open decision: the map's geocoder. `d2d_properties.geocode_status` defaults to `'ok'`, and the add-house dialog
takes address fields the rep types. No reverse-geocode call is made yet. Decide whether to add one or keep manual
entry (DoorBoss is effectively manual).

Next: the call-workspace port (`docs/wholesale/phases/CALL-SCREEN-PORT.md`) - `CallWorkspace.tsx` is still
unwritten, which is what leaves `src/lib/voice/BrowserPhone.ts` and `src/components/call/CoachPanel.tsx` with no
host screen.
